items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and structural repair. Produce one square rough hand-painted anime game martial illustration, Fatal Pierce / 致命穿刺.
REFERENCE ROLES: Input 1, fatal-pierce-v2.png, is the composition and background target. Preserve its extremely close crop, huge curved dark blue-charcoal armor surface filling the left/bottom and continuing beyond the frame, the torn bright rim just left of center, and the neutral warm-gray background appearing in the upper-right gap. Keep that gray/blue background palette and coverage. Input 2, martial-tt2-block.webp, is ACTION-COMPOSITION AND PAINT reference: tightly cropped opposing forms converging at one impact, bold large light-dark masses, selective directional paint and a background supporting that force. Do not copy its hand, sword or gauntlet. Input 3, martial-tt3-blood-arrow.webp, is PAINT AND COLOR-ECONOMY reference only: one readable weapon silhouette and restrained crimson accent, not its arrow pose or burgundy backdrop.
REPAIR THE PRIMARY ACTION in input 1: it currently looks like a blunt horizontal metal bar lodged against a plate. Instead show one coherent STEEL SPEARHEAD erupting from a tight torn armor opening, base at the impact slightly left of center, broad near blade projecting in pronounced perspective toward the lower-right foreground. The weapon has a clean long pointed blade, continuous central ridge and two main blade planes, pale cold silver above and muted blue-gray below. Its near tip is larger than its receding socket. Crop the distal end near the lower-right edge if needed; do not fit a complete weapon into the picture. The short dark shaft recedes from the opening toward the upper-left and exits the frame, partly concealed by the torn metal. No crossguard, transverse blunt bar, sword handle or detached blade.
At the puncture show two large thick metal lips curling toward the viewer, with narrow newly torn IVORY-WHITE edges immediately beside a DEEP BLACK cavity. This concentrated white-black contrast at the contact is the strongest local contrast in the image. Main blade surface highlights are subdued so the large weapon does not overwhelm the puncture. One compact deep crimson mark runs along the opening. A partially cropped short crimson tassel ties directly behind the socket and whips back toward upper left, mostly occluded and secondary. Two nearby pieces of armor push apart from the contact, visibly overlapping the rim at different scales; no scattered floating decorative debris. Preserve a connected armor surface rather than separate freestanding scraps. Neutral gray-blue and dirty ivory background sweeps align with the thrust and converge at the contact, staying within the target image's backdrop palette. Avoid an independent rectangular panel, white border or display pedestal.
Read first as metal being forcibly punctured at one instant, second as forward thrust, third as weapon material. Tense asymmetric crop and overlapping foreground forms; use the whole square for the action.

STYLE: hand-painted anime concept illustration built from large opaque connected color masses and a limited set of wide directional curved or elongated strokes. Clear grouped shadows, decisive handmade edges, selective paint overlaps and broken stroke endings surrounded by quieter areas. Stroke shape explains the armor's curve, torn edges and blade planes. Keep one or two broad midtone turns on curved metal and a few selective dark structural marks at the puncture. Material uses broad opaque silver highlights and gray-blue reflected planes, no photographic chrome or smooth gradients. Concentrate drawing and edges at the impact; secondary shaft, tassel and background remain economical. Muted blue-gray, charcoal, warm gray and off-white with small dark crimson accents. Do not cover every surface with brush texture or flatten every interior to solid fill. No small triangular mosaics, dense scratch networks, granular filters, glossy 3D, airbrush, particle clouds, ornate engraving, humans, hands, gore, text, watermark, border or UI.
